en_title: Game of Thrones Movie Aegon’s Conquest Sets 2029 Release Date With Director Owen Harris
subtitle: 坦格利安征服启幕
opus_summary: 华纳兄弟宣布，《权力的游戏》首部院线电影《Aegon’s Conquest》将于2029年6月9日上映，由Owen Harris执导。影片改编自George R.R. Martin的《血与火》，讲述伊耿一世征服七大王国的故事。

paragraphs.en: Warner Bros. has officially announced a release date and director for Game of Thrones: Aegon’s Conquest , the first feature film to stem from the HBO franchise.
paragraphs.cn: 华纳兄弟正式公布了《权力的游戏：Aegon’s Conquest》的上映日期和导演。这将是该HBO系列推出的首部院线电影。

paragraphs.en: Game of Thrones: Aegon’s Conquest will open in theaters on June 9, 2029. Owen Harris will direct from a screenplay by Beau Willimon (House of Cards). The film will adapt material from George R.R. Martin’s Targaryen history book, Fire & Blood.
paragraphs.cn: 《权力的游戏：Aegon’s Conquest》将于2029年6月9日在影院上映。Owen Harris将执导本片，剧本由Beau Willimon负责，他曾担任《纸牌屋》的编剧。影片将改编自George R.R. Martin所著的坦格利安家族史书《血与火》。

paragraphs.en: Harris is no stranger to Game of Thrones, having directed episodes of A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms . Harris also directed three acclaimed episodes of Black Mirror ("Be Right Back", "San Junipero", and "Striking Vipers").
paragraphs.cn: Harris并不陌生于《权力的游戏》系列，他曾执导《七王国的骑士》中的剧集。此外，他还执导过《黑镜》的三集广受好评的剧集，分别是「马上回来」「圣朱尼佩罗」和「全新恶邻」。

paragraphs.en: Martin’s Fire & Blood chronicles the history of the dragon-riding Targaryen dynasty, including the Dance of the Dragons civil war depicted in House of the Dragon . The Targaryens arrived in Westeros following the Doom of Valyria , settling on the island of Dragonstone . By the time Aegon reached adulthood, he made it his mission to unite the long-warring Seven Kingdoms under the rule of one man: himself.
paragraphs.cn: Martin的《血与火》记述了骑龙的坦格利安王朝历史，其中包括《龙之家族》所描绘的「血龙狂舞」内战。瓦雷利亚末日降临后，坦格利安家族来到维斯特洛，并定居于龙石岛。伊耿成年后，立志让长期交战的七大王国臣服于一位统治者，也就是他自己。

paragraphs.en: Aegon I Targaryen is responsible for countless deaths in his quest to become the sole ruler of the realm. He’s aided by his sister-wives Visenya and Rhaenys. All three siblings fly fearsome dragons: Aegon rides Balerion the Black Dread , Visenya rides Vhagar (yes, the same giant beast flown by Aemond in House of the Dragon ), and Rhaenys flies Meraxes.
paragraphs.cn: 伊耿一世·坦格利安为了成为王国唯一的统治者，造成了无数人死亡。他的两位姐妹兼妻子韦赛里斯和雷妮丝为其提供协助。三人都驾驭着令人畏惧的巨龙：伊耿骑乘「黑死神」贝勒里恩，韦赛里斯骑乘瓦格哈尔（没错，就是《龙之家族》中由伊蒙德驾驭的那头巨兽），雷妮丝则骑乘梅拉克斯。

paragraphs.en: Aegon battles a slew of kingdoms during the Conquest, but his two biggest adversaries are King Harren the Black, the wicked lord of Harrenhal , and Meria Martell, the princess of Dorne. Meria and Dorne’s resistance against Aegon the Conqueror was notably recalled by Ormund Hightower to Daeron Targaryen in House of the Dragon Season 3, Episode 5.
paragraphs.cn: 征服期间，伊耿与多个王国交战，但他最大的两个对手分别是赫伦堡的邪恶领主「黑赫伦」国王，以及多恩公主梅丽娅·马泰尔。在《龙之家族》第3季第5集中，奥蒙德·海塔尔曾向戴伦·坦格利安讲起梅丽娅和多恩抵抗「征服者伊耿」的往事。

paragraphs.en: The Game of Thrones series has established that Aegon knew about the White Walkers and passed this secret knowledge down the generations from ruler to ruler. Aegon foresaw a great looming terror in the North, which convinced him that a Targaryen must occupy the Iron Throne when that dark day arrives to ensure humanity’s survival.
paragraphs.cn: 《权力的游戏》系列已经设定，伊耿知晓异鬼的存在，并将这一秘密知识代代相传，由一任统治者传给下一任。伊耿预见到北方即将降临的巨大灾难，因此认定当黑暗之日到来时，必须由坦格利安家族成员坐上铁王座，才能确保人类存活。

paragraphs.en: Bringing Aegon’s Conquest to the big screen poses a host of challenges for the filmmakers, several of which I break down here .
paragraphs.cn: 要将《Aegon’s Conquest》搬上大银幕，电影主创将面临诸多挑战，我会在这里分析其中几项。
